title: AlphaApta open model checkpoints and sequence-masked single-cell and Cell-SELEX abundance matrices
description: Open reproducibility deposit for AlphaApta, a multimodal computational framework for cell-conditioned aptamer design. This release provides: (1) retained Stage 1 HyenaDNA D1, Stage 2 GNN-Transformer D2, and six-fold leave-one-cell-line-out Stage 3 energy-based D3 model checkpoints (AlphaApta_Model_Checkpoints_v2.tar.zst); (2) primary BD Rhapsody single-cell RNA and AbSeq RSEC UMI count matrices, 50-dimensional WNN coordinates, and sequence-masked Stage 2 single-cell aptamer UMI count matrices in MatrixMarket format (AlphaApta_SingleCell_Count_Matrices.zip); and (3) all 109,321,575 normalized Round-15 Cell-SELEX relative-abundance records with nucleotide strings masked by length-matched N characters and anonymous record identifiers (AlphaApta_Round15_SELEX_SequenceRedacted.tsv.zst).
